# Evergreen

> Evergreen is local-first deprecation intelligence for software repositories. It finds end-of-life and deprecated runtimes, packages, and GitHub Actions at exact file locations, backs every claim with an authoritative source, and produces migration context for humans and coding agents. It runs on your machine through a CLI, a local MCP server, a GitHub Action, and Agent Skills; scans never use the network and need no account.

Before adding a dependency, check it: call the `check_dependency` MCP tool or run `npx evergreen-deprecation check <purl>`. A `no-data` answer means Evergreen has no rule for the package, not that it is safe. The full text of every page below is in [llms-full.txt](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/llms-full.txt).

## Use Evergreen

- [90-second demo](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/DEMO.html): scan, explain, build migration context, and verify on a small repository.
- [Local MCP server](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/MCP.html): the tools, resources, prompt, and output schemas an agent can use, including `check_dependency`.
- [MCP discovery](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/.well-known/mcp.json): stdio server metadata, npm package, and tool list for agents that probe `/.well-known/mcp.json`.
- [Agent card](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/.well-known/agent.json): A2A agent card describing Evergreen's local MCP skills for agents that probe `/.well-known/agent.json`.
- [GitHub Action](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/GITHUB_ACTION.html): run Evergreen in pull requests, gate on severity, upload SARIF to code scanning.
- [Organization rollout](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/ORG_ROLLOUT.html): scan every repository in an organization with one reusable workflow, accept findings with a baseline, and post a weekly digest.
- [GitLab](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/GITLAB.html): the CI/CD component, the permissions it needs, its network behavior, and self-managed constraints.
- [Hooks](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/HOOKS.html): a Git pre-push hook that scans before every push, a Claude Code PreToolUse hook that blocks deprecated package installs, a Cursor rule, and a Copilot instructions file that make the agent check a dependency with Evergreen before adding it.
- [Capability manifest](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/CAPABILITIES.html): how a tool or agent discovers what Evergreen can do, programmatically.
- [Migration packets](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/MIGRATION_PACKETS.html): the structured context Evergreen builds for one finding.
- [Environment doctor and compatibility](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/COMPATIBILITY.html): supported ecosystems, hosts, and maturity.
- [Agent Skill](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/AGENT_SKILLS.html): the portable skill for coding agents and how its triggering is evaluated.
- [Evergreen, Slipway, and Seaworthy](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/SITE_STACK.html): the agent loop for a Slipway-shaped site — check dependencies with Evergreen, verify `_site/` with Seaworthy when it ships.

## Evidence, data, and trust

- [Lifecycle rules](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/RULES.html): the rule format, the evidence policy, and how to write a rule.
- [Lifecycle data](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/DATA.html): signed data updates, pinning, offline guarantees, and the trust model.
- [Validation](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/VALIDATION.html): the public corpus, precision thresholds, and measured results.
- [State of EOL](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/state-of-eol.html): corpus findings aggregated by product and release line.
- [Privacy](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/PRIVACY.html): what stays on your machine and the one command that uses the network.
- [Threat model](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/THREAT_MODEL.html): trust boundaries, STRIDE threats, mitigations, and residual risks for untrusted repositories, data bundles, the MCP server, and hooks.

## Extend Evergreen

- [Detector authoring](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/DETECTORS.html): the detector SDK and how to start a new detector from a generated skeleton.
- [Lifecycle importers](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/IMPORTERS.html): drafting rules from authoritative sources for review.

## Optional

- [Claude plugin](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/CLAUDE_PLUGIN.html): install Evergreen, its Skill, and the dependency guard in Claude Code.
- [Codex plugin](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/CODEX_PLUGIN.html): install Evergreen and the dependency guard in Codex.
- [Releasing](https://arminazimi.github.io/evergreen/RELEASING.html): how maintainers publish packages and signed data.
